properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 780457

Nearest City: LA
Incident Type: PLATFORM
Material: DRILLING FLUID (SYNTHETIC BASED)
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: BP AMOCO PRODUCTION CO
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 12012 gallons
INFORMATION RECEIVED VIA WEB REPORT:DRILLING FLUIDS (SYNTHETIC BASED MUD - SBM)WAS RELEASED DURING THE PLUG AND ABANDON OPERATION ON AN INCOMPLETE WELL THAT FAILED DURING THE DRILLING PROCESS.
